hypotheses.title: Batch 94: High-Conviction Orthogonal Frontiers & Cautious Structural Yield Sprint
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Directly implements the user's suggestion to explore different data fields with radical uniqueness and disciplined caution. Formulates three high-conviction structural anomalies across three orthogonal domains with zero overlap against today's three approved alphas: (1) Candidate 1: Standardized Unexpected Cash Flow (CF-SUE) & Yield in analyst4, measuring the reported cash flow surprise relative to sell-side consensus (actual_cashflow_per_share_value_quarterly - anl4_afv4_cfps_mean) normalized by price. (2) Candidate 2: Structural Credit Deleveraging & Cash Reserves in fundamental, penalizing high liabilities-to-capital ratios while longing peak cash yields (cash_st / close). (3) Candidate 3: Long-Horizon LEAP Variance Risk Premium (720d call IV vs 120d Parkinson realized volatility) in option8/options, capturing institutional structural tail-risk demand. All candidates are 100% unit-clean, zero warnings, zero signed_power, and zero price-delta hedges.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha fails if cash flow surprise, balance sheet deleveraging, or 2-year LEAP VRP contango fail to produce Sharpe >= 1.25 and Fitness >= 1.50 under subindustry neutralization.

candidates.rationale: Candidate 1 (Cash Flow SUE Surprise & Yield): Pairs 180-day historical percentile cash flow yield with the unexpected cash flow surprise relative to sell-side consensus forecasts. Cash flow is immune to accounting accrual manipulation, making CF-SUE a powerful fundamental driver of Post-Earnings Announcement Drift. Evaluated in TOP1000 Subindustry Neutral with Decay 5.

Candidate 2 (Balance Sheet Deleveraging & Cash Solvency): Merton structural credit risk model. Fades companies with elevated balance sheet liabilities relative to total capital, while longing companies holding historically elevated cash reserves (cash_st / close). Evaluated in TOP1000 Subindustry Neutral with Decay 5.

Candidate 3 (Long-Horizon LEAP VRP Contango): Exploits the institutional volatility risk premium where asset managers systematically overpay for 2-year LEAP call protection relative to 120-day Parkinson realized volatility. Evaluated in TOP1000 Subindustry Neutral with Decay 6.
